$comment: Where each harness reads per-user assets, shared by scripts/install-assets.mjs and scripts/install-assets.ps1. `from` is a generated folder in the repository, `to` the per-user folder; every entry of `from` is installed into `to`. Variables: {home}, {xdgConfig} (XDG_CONFIG_HOME, else {home}/.config, also on Windows), {vscodeUser} (VS Code user data, default profile), {claudePlugin}. `skipIfSelected`: Copilot also reads ~/.claude/skills and ~/.claude/agents, so with claude selected the copilot copies would show up twice. Checked 2026-10; see docs/harness-notes.md.
